subtitles.en: Alex, you look sharp! Have a wonderful recording session!
subtitles.zh: Alex，你看起來超有精神的！祝你錄音順利喔！

subtitles.en: Wait, what? I said have a great day and you said same here?
subtitles.zh: 等等，什麼？我祝你有美好的一天，你居然回「我也是」？

subtitles.en: Yeah, because I want a great day too.
subtitles.zh: 對啊，因為我也想過得很好嘛。

subtitles.en: Alex, you sound so self-centered right now.
subtitles.zh: Alex，你這樣聽起來超自私的耶。

subtitles.en: Same here just meant me too.
subtitles.zh: Same here 不就只是「我也一樣」的意思嗎？

subtitles.en: Classic mistake. You cannot use it for wishes.
subtitles.zh: 這是典型錯誤！祝福別人的時候不能用啦。

subtitles.en: It sounds like only wishing yourself luck.
subtitles.zh: 這樣聽起來像你只祝福自己有好運。

subtitles.en: When someone gives you a wish, say same to you to pass the luck back.
subtitles.zh: 當別人祝福你時，要說 same to you 把好運回傳給對方。

subtitles.en: So same to you is like a tennis volley?
subtitles.zh: 所以 same to you 就像打網球回擊一樣？

subtitles.en: I hope you get a million views today.
subtitles.zh: 祝你今天的影片破百萬觀看！
